description: This file contains unit tests for the ScreenController component of an iOS application, focusing on WebView configuration, navigation, JavaScript execution, URL trust validation, and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A controller managing a WebView for displaying and interacting with web content within the app.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: A coordinator handling the lifecycle and configuration of the WebView associated with ScreenController.

classes.name: ScreenControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests validating the behavior of ScreenController and its related components.

methods.name: mountScreen
methods.description: A helper function to set up the ScreenController with its WebView and coordinator for testing.

methods.name: canvasModeConfiguresWebViewForTouch
methods.description: Test that canvas mode enables proper touch configuration on the WebView.

methods.name: navigateEnablesScrollForWebPages
methods.description: Test that navigation to a URL enables scrolling within the WebView.

methods.name: navigateSlashShowsDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Test that navigating to the root URL shows default content.

methods.name: evalExecutesJavaScript
methods.description: Test that JavaScript evaluation within the WebView executes correctly and returns expected results.

methods.name: trustedRemoteA2UIURLMustMatchExactly
methods.description: Test that only exact URL matches are trusted for A2UI interactions.

methods.name: genericNavigationClearsTrustedRemoteA2UIURL
methods.description: Test that navigating away clears the trusted URL.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBodyAcceptsJSONString
methods.description: Test that JSON strings are correctly parsed into action bodies.
